name: Resource family selected without an attached-resource context -> RESOURCE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED, input preserved
note: IAM-1001 suite-3 test 69, updated for IAM-1201. The resource family is now ACCEPTED, but its context is explicit and required: 'who can act on this resource' is only meaningful relative to a known attached resource. Selecting Resource with NO attached-resource context (type + ARN) fails closed with RESOURCE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED - still a blocking coverage state with zero findings and no public-access finding, and the input is preserved so the user can supply the context and re-analyze.
